Recording

  • CURIE: gmeow:Recording
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Recording
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/creative-works

A concrete audio manifestation of a musical work or expression — a take, master, released track, or any other fixed sound recording. Co-equal sibling of gmeow:ScoreEdition and other manifestations (Principle 9).

Structure

Subclass of: gmeow:Manifestation

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:Recording as a specialized kind of gmeow:Manifestation. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:Manifestation
